review_tool_sources.scope: Only added verifier checks and CPU fixtures; replayed the 52-case and 24-case retained matrices. Identified malformed additional summary bypass, which was fixed and regression tested before this report was finalized.

FP8 E4M3 finite decoder, signed zero numerically equal; all raw bytes, independent K=0 beta*C

causal_observation.interpretation: For the tested beta=0 configurations, the three-guard backport on the unchanged 4.1 base removed all 10 observed empty-K timeouts while preserving both positive controls.

limitations: This migrates the upstream report to H100/CUDA13.1/driver610.57.04 and M=N=128; it is not the original H800/CUDA12.4/M=N=4096 environment. The original 32 K splits were retained for issue32-reduced.
No TMA descriptor error text appeared in the retained failed logs. Timeouts support bounded noncompletion; no PC trace or dynamic instruction-level evidence identifies an individual wait instruction.
The three-guard combination is isolated to one library header, but guards were not individually ablated. It does not establish a mathematically minimal necessary patch.
Old beta=1 fails both nonzero-K positive controls. All 12 beta=1 failures remain a separate confounder; they are not evidence of empty-K causality and beta=1 backport behavior was not tested.
Only K=0 uses the independent beta*C oracle. K>0 compares all outputs to the retained upstream CPU-reference result; A/B/scaling inputs were not archived for an independent GEMM oracle recomputation.
The four memcheck runs cover only release 4.2. Neither old-release nor backport sanitizer cleanliness is claimed.

Each matrix cell has one process invocation; shapes and host modes are not independent natural bugs or estimates of failure frequency. A source-level repair is not an automatic checker root-cause diagnosis.

verifier_hardening.group_ids: Integer in range and unique for every record; complete set required only for passed records; arrival order not constrained.
verifier_hardening.stdout_binding: Raw stdout EVIDENCE JSON is reparsed and compared to record groups. Raw stdout/stderr must appear in the checked file manifest.
verifier_hardening.sanitizer_binding: sanitizer_clean must equal memcheck + passed + exit0 + no timeout + raw Compute Sanitizer banner + exactly one complete zero-error summary.
verifier_hardening.semantics_preserved: Failed/timeout records may retain partial or empty groups. Numerical passed and sanitizer_clean remain separate fields. Existing verification JSON files are byte-identical after hardening.
verifier_hardening.outer_upload_hash_validation: Performed separately in the independent review and archive workflow, not coupled into cutlass_verify.py.
